newsitem.title: USA: US domestic auto sales -5.8 pct Dec 11-20 vs 1995.
newsitem.headline: US domestic auto sales -5.8 pct Dec 11-20 vs 1995.

text.p: U.S. domestic automobile sales declined 5.8 percent in the 10 days of December 11-20 compared with the same period a year ago, according to a report by CNW Marketing/Research.
Domestic car sales fell 2.3 percent to 155,592, while domestic truck sales slipped 9.6 percent to 129,806, CNW said.
Import car sales declined 6.0 percent to 42,089, and import truck sales dipped 12.1 percent to 8,886, it said.
Of the vehicles sold during the survey period, 34.2 percent were leased, up from 32.7 percent a year ago, CNW said.
